need.description: The need in the program office's own words

context.description: JSON: agency, requiring office, neededBy (yyyy-mm-dd or null), budget (dollars or null), kindHint

answers.description: JSON array of {question, answer} from earlier rounds. An answer starting '(skipped' means the program office doesn't know yet

draft.description: JSON: the structured requirement so far, as the program office last saved it

kind.description: One of: Product, Service, Product and service

title.description: A short title, at most 8 words, no agency name

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what is being bought, for whom, and anything a Contracting Officer will notice first

pscCode.description: Suggested product and service code, or ''

sizeStandard.description: The SBA size standard for that NAICS code, e.g. '1,250 employees' or '$34.0M', or ''

commercialLikely.description: Whether this is likely a commercial product or commercial service

valueLow.description: Low end of the likely total value in dollars, or 0 when there isn't enough to estimate

valueBasis.description: One sentence: the quantities and unit prices or rates the range comes from

flags.description: Facts in the need or answers that change the package. Empty when none

id.description: One of: brandName, ict, cui, classified, onBase, soleSource, urgent, hazmat

label.description: Short label, e.g. 'A brand is named'

reason.description: One sentence quoting or naming what in the need triggers it

questions.description: Up to 6 questions a Contracting Officer would otherwise send the package back for. Empty when nothing important is missing

why.description: One sentence on why it matters to the package

options.description: Two or three likely answers of at most 6 words each, or [] when the answer is free text
